name: llama-monitor
title: llama.cpp Monitor
description: Save llama.cpp engines, inspect model and host telemetry, and record monitoring sessions with low, peak and average readings.

read_engine.description: Read llama.cpp and host collector telemetry through exact admin-approved named connections.

parse_snapshot.description: Normalize a supplied llama.cpp and collector snapshot without making network calls.

summarize_session.description: Calculate session statistics from supplied telemetry samples.

settings.label: Approved connection paths (JSON)
settings.help: Admin-approved exact GET paths, for example engine_api: /health, /v1/models, /props, /metrics; optional host_metrics: /telemetry. Replace example connection names with your own. Calling users also need permission in Secrets → Connect API.

companions.title: Host telemetry collector
companions.description: Optional read-only service providing CPU, RAM and AMD GPU metrics. Engine metrics work without it.
companions.runsOn: The Linux machine hosting the engine; use the physical host for physical RAM readings
requirements: Readable Linux procfs and AMD DRM sysfs for GPU readings
dataAccess: Optional process RSS and cgroup memory counters
companions.privileges: Administrator installs the service and provisions its credential. Runtime uses an unprivileged dynamic user with read-only system access.
